topic: Actually searching for prior attempts at similar engineering problems: software projects, technical ideas, adoption history; generating queries, running web searches, synthesizing a cited prior-art report

patent prior art vs technical prior art distinction

subtopics.scope: Restating a raw idea or question as a one-sentence search anchor; framing the topic so searches answer something concrete.
seed_queries: writing effective search queries product competitive research
search query formulation information retrieval precision

subtopics.scope: Generating 3 to 5 concrete queries across four angles: direct competitors, failed attempts, academic or formal, adjacent or historical; specificity over abstraction.
seed_queries: competitive landscape search queries alternatives comparison best practices
searching for failed startups postmortems why products failed

subtopics.scope: The bounded search protocol: 3-5 searches, 2-3 fetches, one pass, no recursion; domain diversity; logging query text and top hits.
seed_queries: token budget web research agent search limits
agentic web search recursion budget control research agents

subtopics.scope: The prior-art report template: four categories (competitors, failed attempts, academic, adjacent/historical), per-entry fields (name, description, source URL, key observation), Sources section.
seed_queries: technology landscape report structure competitive analysis document
market research report format cited sources sections

subtopics.scope: The What-this-means section: competitive landscape, why previous attempts failed, why no one has tried this, open opportunity; translating research into judgment about the idea.
seed_queries: postmortem failed products lessons learned product decisions
competitive analysis white space market gap opportunity assessment

subtopics.scope: Selection bias as the defining failure mode: surfacing only successful prior art, single-domain results, fabricated findings, uncited claims, skipping fetches, missing translation, recursion without bound; red flags list.

search result bias domain diversity web research methodology
